supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:24 UTC, the domain account helpdesk2 was created by ali.hassan.

At 13:45:34 UTC, helpdesk2 was added to the MAPLEHILL Administrators group by ali.hassan. This conflicts with the supplied practice that help-desk temporary accounts use temp.<name> and are never given administrator rights.

At 13:45:34 UTC, ali.hassan created a scheduled task on WS-NKIM-01 whose hidden PowerShell command uses an encoded argument that decodes to fetching and executing a script from http://198.51.100.201/a.ps1.

Shortly before the account creation, ali.hassan logged on to WS-NKIM-01 through an RDP logon from 198.51.100.201. The supplied context says remote administration is only done from WS-AHASSAN-01 and there is no VPN; this is inconsistent with that practice, though the records do not establish that this session caused the account changes.

known_telemetry_limitations: The account creation and group-addition records identify ali.hassan and logon ID 0x807d049, but the provided evidence does not show the authentication or source session corresponding to that logon ID. [T177-00064, T177-00065]
The scheduled-task record shows the task definition and its command, but the provided records do not show whether the task ran or whether the script was retrieved or executed. [T177-00066]

The RDP logon is recorded under logon ID 0x111bbf7d, which differs from the account changes' logon ID 0x807d049; a direct link between those events is not established. [T177-00046, T177-00064, T177-00065]
claims_not_established: Whether ali.hassan personally performed or authorized the account creation, administrator-group addition, or scheduled-task creation.
Whether helpdesk2 was subsequently used, and whether it remains enabled or has other privileges.
Whether the scheduled task executed or its referenced script was successfully retrieved.
Who controlled the RDP source address 198.51.100.201, or whether it is directly connected to the account-management events.
additional_evidence_needed: Investigate the origin and authentication details for DC-MAP-01 logon ID 0x807d049 and correlate it with ali.hassan's sessions and the account changes.
Confirm with ali.hassan through a trusted channel whether the account creation and administrator-group addition were authorized.
Preserve and examine WS-NKIM-01 task execution, PowerShell, network, and endpoint telemetry for activity associated with the task and its referenced URL.
Check helpdesk2's current status, group memberships, authentication history, and any access or changes made after creation.
Identify and investigate the source of the RDP connection recorded from 198.51.100.201.
unrelated_findings: WS-NKIM-01 made a browser CONNECT request to docs.google.com; the supplied inventory does not list Google Docs as an approved cloud-storage or file-sharing service. This is separate from deciding the account-management alert. [T177-00053, T177-00054]
